_comment: Token classes removed during normalization. All matching is case-insensitive, whole-token, and never applied to the first token so titles like 'PC Building Simulator' survive.
_noiseComment: Unconditionally dropped: distribution, packaging and platform noise that is never part of a real title.
_languageComment: Language and region markers. Also matched as glued suffixes on a single-token name (e.g. SubaHibiEN).
_editionComment: Edition markers are NOT stripped from the primary normalized name — 'The Last of Us Remastered' is a different game from 'The Last of Us'. They instead generate an additional, lower-weighted search candidate with them removed.
_versionComment: Backstop regexes matched against whole tokens, anchored at both ends. Version *phrases* that span separators ('Update 6', 'v2.1') are handled earlier by NameNormalizer's phrase pass; these catch the leftovers.
